about_the_game:
From the twisted depths of 80s and 90s trash-horror cinema comes HandFoot — a blood-soaked, neon-drenched nightmare where every gun is more than a gun. You play as a hard-boiled private detective investigating a string of disappearances in the decaying industrial sprawl of Massacre City. All leads point to a run-down kitten food factory — and what’s inside will change you forever.

HandFoot blends grotesque action, physics-driven combat, and gritty stealth into one chaotic ride.
Shoot, smash, throw, and improvise with any weapon in your hands. When bullets aren’t enough, slow time and use your surroundings to turn enemies into debris.

But violence isn’t always the answer. Crawl through vents, climb across rooftops, and sneak through the shadows to stalk your targets or avoid detection entirely. Solve light environmental puzzles, uncover clues, and piece together the grim mystery behind the factory’s secrets.

Whether you fight or hide, every move counts — and every mistake leaves a stain.

Key Features

  • Bullet-Time Combat: Slow down time to unleash cinematic destruction.

  • Weapon Versatility: Every gun doubles as a melee weapon — shoot, smash, or throw it straight into someone’s skull.

  • Stealth & Exploration: Hide, climb, crawl, and sneak through dark industrial zones and twisted environments.

  • Environmental Puzzles: Simple but clever challenges that reveal hidden paths and lore.

  • Grindhouse Aesthetic: Inspired by 80s–90s trash horror with over-the-top gore, grim humor, and VHS-era attitude.

  • Physics-Driven Gore: Dismember enemies, blast apart bodies, and paint the walls with chaos.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent depictions of graphic violence, gore, and dismemberment presented in an over-the-top, exaggerated style inspired by 80s/90s trash horror movies. Enemies can be shot, smashed, or impaled with weapons, and blood effects are prominent.

The game does not include sexual assault, non-consensual sex, or depictions of self-harm. References to alcohol and sleazy horror themes may appear in the setting.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux + Proton
  • Processor: Intel i3-10100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 570 (or equivalent, 4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated GPUs (e.g., Vega 8) can run the game at only ~30 FPS.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux + Proton
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 / AMD RX 580 (or equivalent)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
